claim: A snap-through event acts as an analogue-to-digital converter: mutual information between the load at which the snap occurred and the post-snap ringdown frequency exceeds a permutation null by a margin not attributable to estimator bias, across damping.
name: snap_information
reason: gamma=0.02: excess MI < 0.2 bits at 5/5 seeds; gamma=0.05: excess MI < 0.2 bits at 5/5 seeds; gamma=0.1: excess MI < 0.2 bits at 5/5 seeds
refute_if: MI(load; ringdown) - MI_null < 0.20 bits at >=3 of 5 seeds in any swept gamma
